(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((bg 7)
         (colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
         (counts (map (lambda (c) (list c (length (find-color g c)))) colors))
         (ranked (sort-by counts (lambda (p) (nth p 1))))
         (marker (nth (first ranked) 0))
         (block (nth (last ranked) 0))
         (objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) block)) (objects g bg)))
         (is-odd (lambda (o)
           (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                  (h (+ 1 (- (nth bb 2) (nth bb 0))))
                  (w (+ 1 (- (nth bb 3) (nth bb 1)))))
             (and (= (mod h 2) 1) (= (mod w 2) 1)))))
         (weight (lambda (o) 1))
         (odd-objs (filter is-odd objs))
         (even-objs (filter (lambda (o) (not (is-odd o))) objs))
         (odd-votes (reduce (lambda (a o) (+ a (weight o))) 0 odd-objs))
         (even-votes (reduce (lambda (a o) (+ a (weight o))) 0 even-objs))
         (keep-cross (> odd-votes even-votes))
         (base (if keep-cross g (recolor g marker bg))))
    (reduce (lambda (acc o)
      (with-bbox o (r1 c1 r2 c2)
        (set-cell acc (+ r1 (/ (- r2 r1) 2))
                      (+ c1 (/ (- c2 c1) 2)) marker)))
      base odd-objs))))
